column8: Fri 20 Nov: 3a or 2.0, the logic in words (when Treasuries only just cover a payment, any slice of shares brings back the whole chance of a miss, so only none is zero), which evaluates IPS l.11 and l.19; fix: 34.5%, $99 and $9,867 are Keel arithmetic on J.P. Morgan's 7.5% and 17.88% (above the middle of published forecasts), a share forecast not in NUMBERS, never a plan figure, so a note or the store at most; 3a's density row has no room for them and Roy stays unnamed there (one outside name a part).

Fri 20 Nov: twin of H7-015 (each claim takes risk only once the claim ahead of it is owned) and NUMBERS 4's deletion test; adds nothing a part needs; never cushion (LOW 2), and the critique's reading of A4 is Keel inference, not the IPS's.

Fri 20 Nov: 3a beside Q189-001, one clause at most: a chance alone counts a $99 miss the same as a $9,867 one, which is why the IPS defines certainty by structure, no payment depending on a share price (CANON A4); the two sums are Keel arithmetic on a share forecast, so say the point in words.
Fri 20 Nov: twin of H1-081 and spine row 2 (ten 99% promises miss at least one about 1 time in 10); the union-bound range adds nothing to it.

Fri 20 Nov: 3a or 2.0, pedigree for TNA l.7's nominal match (CANON A14): Roy's one clause on a holding with no spread, complete and blissful security, is where the ladder sits in dollars; pairs with Q57-001; competes for 3a's one outside name; the building's costs stay in real terms, outside it.

Fri 20 Nov: 2.3 or 3b, one quoted clause at most: the payments are rocks of known position and her flexibility meets the facility's rocks of uncertain position (IPS l.15's three uses); fix: never a running navigation image (sea room) beside pencil and ink, and never in tables.

Fri 20 Nov: 3f only as the team's own fact behind the turn the first plan's payments were in pencil (Q174-005), with no Roy in 3f; fix: the uncertain position came from the shares the money sat in (the four years at 75% carry 76.5% of the gap, the 2033 yield 2.9%, NUMBERS 8s), so never imply the 2033 price was the danger, and never give it as the reason the first plan was dropped (CANON A3, IPS l.9).
Fri 20 Nov: the same Roy passage as Q57-003, merged into Q13-008; one market path for ten payments matches NUMBERS 8s (every miss settled on 1 Jan 2033), a clause, not a row.
Fri 20 Nov: twin of Q79-020 (merged into Q79-018); its new use breaks Q79-018's guard, never an image in a table (V2.4 guard 4), so Table 3 carries no chart labels.
Fri 20 Nov: store; a thin parallel for IPS l.15's moving top: Roy's revision is a wish he declines to model, while Laura's top is set by a dated rule and is no disaster level, so a clause at most.

Fri 20 Nov: 3c, why the bottom comes from the late-2032 fund and nothing is stated before the move: at a chance of zero shares give $0 and the fund gives what its holdings pay with no more interest, the range rule's own measure (NUMBERS 0 and 4); say it without Kataoka's name (3c's one outside name is Neyman's) and never call the fund's payout fixed.

Fri 20 Nov: References and pedigree for Q189-011; fix: a Value at Risk at a chance of zero sits against Q8b-013's settled note (the standard is a scenario test passed by construction, not a value-at-risk), so say a worst case already owned, not a quantile, or keep Value at Risk to References.
Fri 20 Nov: store only; the transport likeness is thin, as the card says, and serves no part.

Fri 20 Nov: 2.0 or 3c, the spine Laura buys first and states second (Q163-001) seen from Roy: his man's disaster level is set by the world, hers is chosen in 2031, so she sets it under what she holds; certain takes the stated range as its subject, and the building's risks stay with co-sponsors and her flexibility.
Fri 20 Nov: Telser is already named in H7-015's order of claims; the hedged-and-unhedged line is read only through Johnson (Telser paywalled); References at most.

Fri 20 Nov: 2.2 or 3b, why VT is in the plan at all: once Treasuries beat the level, Roy's ratio alone wants no shares, and only a second step (seek return with money not yet promised) lets VT in; Keel inference on Roy's geometry, never optimal.
Fri 20 Nov: restates IPS l.15 and H7-015 (what she keeps comes last in the order of claims); the IPS never says speculation, so no contrast with it.
Fri 20 Nov: the base of Q189-019; 91% at twelve years and 48% one-sided check out (Keel arithmetic on J.P. Morgan's 8.94% and 17.88%), a share forecast, never a plan figure.

Fri 20 Nov: 3c's store or Table 2's note, behind spine row 1: a share-based 95% is worth nothing, 36, 73 or 79 cents by the curve assumed (Keel arithmetic, checked; J.P. Morgan's inputs, a forecast, never a plan figure); 3c's prose has no room for its figures, Roy stays unnamed there, and no 95% ever stands beside the range.

Fri 20 Nov: 3a or 3e, the ladder needs no estimate of an average or a spread, only the price paid in January 2027 (TNA l.15, not merely a forecast), while Roy himself called assuming them known optimistic; true of promised money only, VT's top still rests on estimates.

Fri 20 Nov: 3e or Table 3's two reasons, a clause at most: a rule built on estimates swings with them, Roy admits, while Laura's mix changes only on three dated steps; Roy allows borrowing and short sales, which the plan never uses.
Fri 20 Nov: the same doubt about estimates as Q189-020, from Roy (1961) read only through Sullivan; References at most.

Fri 20 Nov: 2.3's lead, one clause of lineage for IPS l.9's career argument (CANON A1-A2); fix: shares, her advances and co-sponsors' budgets can fall in the same downturn, never fall with or together (card Q50); Roy unnamed if 2.3's one outside name goes to the pencil ruling.
Fri 20 Nov: 3a store; fix: a missed payment loses a year's $50,000 base, never a year of operations unfunded ($50,000 is a base, not a whole budget, H9-119).
Fri 20 Nov: voice store for IPS l.9 with l.19 (a taste for thoughtful risk, none with the promises); never a claim about Laura's character beyond the case's words.

Fri 20 Nov: twin of Q17-020 (the highest Sharpe ratio belongs to the return-seeking holding); the market-portfolio step needs Sharpe (1964), not read; VT's reason stays the team's own (Trading Note 3, no picking winners), never Roy's ratio.
Fri 20 Nov: lineage trivia beside Q57-008 (Roy's equal share of the honour); Markowitz (1999) unread, quoted through Sullivan; References at most.
Fri 20 Nov: the same lineage as Q57-008, Markowitz (1987) through Tarrazo, unread; References only.
Fri 20 Nov: colour with no part to serve (Book 18: a purpose for everything), and its use line states Sullivan's guess that the war shaped the paper as fact (written by a man who had been in one).
Fri 20 Nov: 3e store, an answer to a known critique: safety-first is sensitive to the chosen critical level, but the case fixes the payments' level and Laura states hers only once it is owned.
Fri 20 Nov: store only; abstract read, findings unverified, and Laura is not near subsistence.
Fri 20 Nov: twin of H9-166 (ruin models need random claims; Laura's are known to the dollar); Cramér unread.
